name: Ranka Shirogane
source: A talented yet indecisive student, good at many things but not particularly apt at many. She bemoans her lack of personality, but never quite develops one, and doesn't become the roaring dragon that her Prister can.
translation: A talented yet indecisive student, good at many things but not particularly apt at many. She bemoans her lack of personality, but never quite develops one, and doesn't become the roaring dragon that her Prister can.
